meta.name: Conference speaker card
meta.description: An event opener and a speaker lower third laid out in HTML and CSS: a wordmark set from text, date and venue badges, the speaker’s name on an accent rule, the talk title wrapped in its own box, and time, room and track badges.
meta.creativeDirection: Audience: event teams who cut a short clip for every talk. Direction: a conference look that holds up on a stage screen and on a phone. The opener is the event: the wordmark rises over the night sky, then the date and venue badges settle under it. A swipe hands over to the speaker beat, where the lower third builds in three steps: the name on its accent rule, the talk title in a box that wraps a long title over two lines, then the time, room and track badges. A small wordmark bug keeps the event on screen. Review: the long talk title wraps without cutting a word, the badges line up with the title box, nothing sits on the right-hand edge, and no layer shows before its entrance.

talk_title.default: HTML cards in a video engine: layouts that fill themselves in

sections.name: opener
sections.purpose: Say which event this is, when and where.

inputs.name: event_wordmark
inputs.css: .mark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px } .one { color: $color.fg; font: 130px $font.display; letter-spacing: 5px } .two { padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 16px; background: $color.accent; color: $color.bg; font: 130px $font.display; letter-spacing: 5px } .mark { justify-content: center }

inputs.name: event_badges
inputs.html: {{ event_date }}{{ event_venue }}
inputs.css: .row { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 14px } .badge { padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid $color.accent; color: $color.fg; font: 500 28px $font.body } .badge.alt { border-color: $color.muted@0.6; background: $color.surface@0.7 }

sections.name: speaker
sections.purpose: Who is speaking, about what, and where to find the talk.

inputs.name: event_bug
inputs.html: {{ event_first }}{{ event_second }}
inputs.css: .mark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px } .one { color: $color.fg; font: 34px $font.display; letter-spacing: 1px } .two { padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: $color.accent; color: $color.bg; font: 34px $font.display; letter-spacing: 1px } .wrap { display: flex; align-items: flex-start } .bug { display: flex; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: $color.bg@0.85 }

inputs.name: speaker_name
inputs.css: .wrap { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; padding: 0 24px 30px } .name { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-grow: 1; padding: 20px 28px 22px; border-left: 10px solid $color.accent; border-radius: 6px 18px 18px 6px; background: $color.bg@0.92; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) } h2 { margin: 0; color: $color.fg; font: 76px $font.display; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 1px } p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: $color.muted; font: 400 26px $font.body }

inputs.name: talk_box
inputs.html:
Now on stage

{{ talk_title }}
inputs.css: .wrap { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; padding: 0 24px 30px } .talk { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-grow: 1; gap: 8px; padding: 20px 26px 24px; border-radius: 18px; background: $color.surface@0.94; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) } .kicker { color: $color.accent; font: 600 18px $font.body; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px } p { margin: 0; color: $color.fg; font: 600 32px $font.body; line-height: 1.2 }

inputs.name: talk_badges
inputs.html: {{ talk_time }}{{ talk_room }}{{ talk_track }}
inputs.css: .row { display: flex; gap: 10px } .badge { padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 12px; background: $color.bg@0.92; color: $color.fg; font: 500 24px $font.body } .badge.time { background: $color.accent; color: $color.bg; font: 700 24px $font.mono }
